posts.text: ADHD means caring deeply… about 14 things at once.
Timers aren’t just for cooking. They’re my ADHD lifeline.
ADHD entrepreneurship: passion on fire, schedule in ashes.
ADHD means talking about one thing and ending up in ancient history.

You've played the same song eleven times straight and you're not even sure why it works. Turns out repetition isn't you being stuck, it's regulation. Musicians who talk ADHD openly have described this exact thing, the same rhythm looping until your nervous system settles into it. For ADHD brains, predictability is dopamine you can actually count on, unlike almost everything else in your day.
If my post comes across your feed and your first thought is “that’s not ADHD,” do yourself a favor and just keep scrolling
